object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Compare with From and To picked from the list, typed as an expression, typed as a hash prefix, as an issue, and as the working copy. Then make a commit and compare again without choosing again. Expected: each result names the commit each version resolved to by at least the first 7 digits of its hash, once; after the new commit, the hash of the commit compared, not the one listed before. The working copy is named as the working copy, with no hash.
